selectedPosts.text: Earlier today, UK union IWGB Game Workers' Branch—in collaboration with members of Game Workers Unite Ireland, Spanish union CSVI, and the FIOM-CGIL Milan Work Council—published a comprehensive manifesto demanding legal protections for game workers who do not wish to use generative AI.
